correctness.rationale: Tame inertia gives five elliptic characters. Transfer-pullback composition is diagonal [8] and yields a prime-to-5 isogeny. Legendre Hasse coefficient computed exactly; three remaining Hasse numerators reduce to -2 under u+v=uv=1. Explicit witnesses verify all three ranks, and F25 standalone computations corroborate finite identities without substituting for the universal algebraic proof.

Sharp char-5 global rank spectrum and unique extremal branch set require an additional simultaneous cross-ratio/Hasse-invariant compatibility result absent from materially read closely related primary texts. Semantic published-finding corpus and published literature checks found no equivalent; residual risks expressly retained.

value.rationale: A complete and sharp p-rank stratification of a natural two-dimensional genus-five family, with all ranks realized and a unique minimum-rank branch configuration. This rules out supersingular Jacobians in the whole smooth locus, identifies an isolated arithmetic extremum, and answers a nontrivial question left open by knowing mere complete decomposition.
